use anyhow::{ensure,Result};
pub use erc20_balances_storage_tools::{data,rpc};
use data::*;use rpc::*;
use primitive_types::U256;
use serde_json::{json,Value};
use std::{fs,path::Path};
#[path="../src/og_model.rs"] mod og_model;
use og_model::fixture::{self,key,word,TOKEN,HELPER,POOL_A};
fn output(v:Result<U256>)->Value {match v {Ok(v)=>json!({"values":[v.to_string()]}),Err(e)=>json!({"error":e.to_string()})}}
pub fn model(v:&Value)->Value{match fixture::decode(v){Err(e)=>json!({"decode_error":e.to_string()}),Ok(s)=>json!({"balance":output(s.evaluate().map(|e|e.balance)),"hourly":match s.hourly(){Ok((v,stop))=>json!({"values":[v.to_string(),stop.to_string()]}),Err(e)=>json!({"error":e.to_string()})},"daily":output(s.daily())})}}
pub fn calls(rpc:&dyn Rpc,v:&Value,diff:&Value)->Result<Value>{let mut calls=vec![];for(to,sel)in [(TOKEN,"70a08231"),(HELPER,"e8e8fe04"),(HELPER,"7ac1f9f8")]{let holder=quantity(&v["holder"])?;let params=json!([{"to":to,"data":format!("0x{sel}{holder:064x}")},block_ref(text(&v["hash"])?),diff,{"time":v["timestamp"]}]);calls.push(("eth_call".into(),params));}let responses=rpc.batch_rows(&calls)?;let mut out=json!({});for(name,r)in ["balance","hourly","daily"].iter().zip(responses){if let Some(encoded)=r["result"].as_str(){let b=hex::decode(encoded.trim_start_matches("0x"))?;ensure!(b.len()%32==0,"bad ABI");out[*name]=json!({"values":b.chunks(32).map(|w|U256::from_big_endian(w).to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>()});}else{out[*name]=json!({"rpc_error":r["error"]});}}Ok(out)}
pub fn field(v:&Value,c:&str,k:U256)->Result<U256>{let row=items(v,"raw_state")?.iter().find(|r|r["contract"]==c&&r["key"]==word(k)).ok_or_else(||anyhow::anyhow!("missing control raw word"))?;quantity(&row["value"])}
pub fn update(v:&mut Value,c:&str,k:U256,value:U256)->Result<()> {let row=v["raw_state"].as_array_mut().unwrap().iter_mut().find(|r|r["contract"]==c&&r["key"]==word(k)).ok_or_else(||anyhow::anyhow!("missing override raw word"))?;row["value"]=json!(word(value));Ok(())}
pub fn classify(m:&Value,e:&Value)->String{if m["decode_error"].is_string()||["balance","hourly","daily"].iter().any(|n|m[n]["error"].as_str().is_some_and(|s|s.starts_with("unmodeled"))){return "explicitly_unsupported".into();}for n in ["balance","hourly","daily"]{if m[n]["values"].is_array(){if m[n]["values"]!=e[n]["values"]{return "mismatch".into();}}else if m[n]["error"].is_string(){if e[n]["rpc_error"]["data"]!=format!("0x4e487b71{:064x}",0x11){return "revert_mismatch".into();}}else{return "mismatch".into();}}"match".into()}
fn main()->Result<()> {let root=Path::new("erc20/balances-storage");let out=root.join("out/og450-model-controls");fs::create_dir(&out)?;let previous:Value=serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(root.join("out/og450-model-capture/report.json"))?)?;let original:Value=serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(root.join("out/next450-mismatch-compact/report.json"))?)?;let rpc=HttpRpc::from_env();let mut cases=vec![];
for c in items(&previous,"cases")? {let id=number(&c["case"])?;ensure!(rpc.header(number(&c["block"])?)?["hash"]==c["hash"],"fork");let binding=&original["cases"][(id-1)as usize]["execution_code"];for b in binding.as_array().unwrap(){let code=rpc.call("eth_getCode",json!([b["address"],block_ref(text(&c["hash"])?)]))?;ensure!(format!("0x{}",hex::encode(erc20_balances_storage::hash(&hex::decode(text(&code)?.trim_start_matches("0x"))?)))==b["runtime_hash"],"runtime mismatch");}
let mut raw:Value=serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(root.join(format!("out/og450-model-capture/case{id}-state.json")))?)?;let mut extra=vec![(TOKEN,6.into()),(HELPER,1.into()),(HELPER,2.into())];let pool=quantity(&json!(POOL_A))?;extra.push((TOKEN,key(&[pool],0)));for offset in 0..12{extra.push((TOKEN,key(&[pool],9)+U256::from(offset)));}let requests=extra.iter().map(|(a,k)|("eth_getStorageAt".into(),json!([a,word(*k),block_ref(text(&c["hash"]).unwrap())]))).collect::<Vec<_>>();for((a,k),value)in extra.into_iter().zip(rpc.batch(&requests)?){raw.as_array_mut().unwrap().push(json!({"contract":a,"key":word(k),"value":value}));}
let mut v=json!({"case":id,"contract":TOKEN,"holder":c["holder"],"block":c["block"],"hash":c["hash"],"timestamp":c["timestamp"],"runtime_bindings":binding,"raw_state":raw});let prediction=model(&v);let expected=calls(&rpc,&v,&json!({}))?;v["model"]=prediction.clone();v["expected"]=expected.clone();v["status"]=json!(classify(&prediction,&expected));cases.push(v);}
fs::write(out.join("historical.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&cases)?)?;
let base=&cases[0];let holder=quantity(&base["holder"])?;let s=fixture::decode(base)?;let rawkey=key(&[holder],0);let record=key(&[holder],9);let cursor=key(&[holder],11);let current=(s.now-s.epoch)/3600;let unit=U256::from(1_000_000_000_000_000_000u64);let price=s.price()?;let available=s.user[3]*U256::from(3)-s.user[12]*price/unit-U256::one();let packed=field(base,POOL_A,8.into())?;let mask=(U256::one()<<112)-1;let mut scenarios=vec![];
for (name,c,k,value) in [
("raw_zero",TOKEN,rawkey,U256::zero()),("raw_one",TOKEN,rawkey,U256::one()),("raw_123",TOKEN,rawkey,123.into()),("raw_max_overflow",TOKEN,rawkey,U256::MAX),
("hour_reward_one",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_hour],24),U256::one()),("hour_total_17",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_hour],23),17.into()),("hour_user_17",TOKEN,key(&[holder,s.last_hour],12),17.into()),
("day_reward_17",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_day],27),17.into()),("day_total_17",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_day],25),17.into()),("day_user_17",TOKEN,key(&[holder,s.last_day],13),17.into()),
("weekly_amount_zero",TOKEN,key(&[holder],40),U256::zero()),("weekly_hour_stale",TOKEN,key(&[holder],39),current-U256::from(169)),("claimed_max",TOKEN,key(&[holder],10),U256::MAX),
("cap_basis_zero",TOKEN,record+U256::from(2),U256::zero()),("cap_remaining_one",TOKEN,key(&[holder],10),available),
("pool_a_quote_reserve_half",POOL_A,8.into(),(packed & !mask)|((packed&mask)/2)),
("holder_hour_rate_zero",TOKEN,record+U256::from(4),U256::zero()),("holder_day_rate_zero",TOKEN,record+U256::from(5),U256::zero()),
("hour_cursor_current",TOKEN,cursor,current),("day_cursor_current",TOKEN,cursor+U256::one(),(s.now-s.epoch)/86400),
("unmodeled_daily_initial_zero",TOKEN,key(&[holder,s.last_day],13),U256::zero()),("unmodeled_hour_reward_zero",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_hour],24),U256::zero()),("unmodeled_day_reward_zero",TOKEN,key(&[s.last_day],27),U256::zero()),
] {scenarios.push((name,vec![(c,k,value)],s.now));}
scenarios.push(("clock_minus_hour",vec![],s.now-U256::from(3600)));scenarios.push(("clock_same_period",vec![],s.now+U256::one()));
let mut controls=vec![];for(name,changes,time)in scenarios {let mut v=base.clone();v["timestamp"]=json!(format!("0x{time:x}"));let mut diff=json!({});let mut delta=vec![];for(c,k,value)in changes{update(&mut v,c,k,value)?;diff[c]["stateDiff"][word(k)]=json!(word(value));delta.push(json!({"contract":c,"key":word(k),"value":word(value)}));}let prediction=model(&v);let expected=calls(&rpc,&v,&diff)?;let status=classify(&prediction,&expected);controls.push(json!({"name":name,"base_case":1,"state_diff":delta,"timestamp":v["timestamp"],"model":prediction,"expected":expected,"status":status}));fs::write(out.join("controls.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&controls)?)?;println!("{name}: {}",controls.last().unwrap()["status"]);}
ensure!(rpc.header(number(&base["block"])?)?["hash"]==base["hash"],"fork after controls");let good=cases.iter().all(|c|c["status"]=="match")&&controls.iter().all(|c|c["status"]=="match"||c["status"]=="explicitly_unsupported");fs::write(out.join("report.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"status":if good{"bounded_parity"}else{"incomplete"},"historical_cases":cases.len(),"controls":controls.len(),"matched_controls":controls.iter().filter(|r|r["status"]=="match").count(),"unsupported_controls":controls.iter().filter(|r|r["status"]=="explicitly_unsupported").count(),"promoted_layouts":0,"historical_sha256":sha256(&out.join("historical.json"))?,"controls_sha256":sha256(&out.join("controls.json"))?,"controls_summary":controls.iter().map(|c|json!({"name":c["name"],"status":c["status"]})).collect::<Vec<_>>()}))?)?;Ok(())}
